description: ZEPY RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Vector DB Security Signatures

signatures.title: Direct Injection of Untrusted RAG Context into System Role
signatures.remediation: Place retrieved RAG context strictly in user/assistant message roles wrapped in data tags (e.g. <context>...</context>), never inside the privileged system prompt.

signatures.title: Unsanitized Metadata Filter Query in Vector Database
signatures.remediation: Parameterize vector database filter dictionaries instead of dynamically formatting string expressions.

signatures.title: Insecure Document Loader (PyPDF / Unstructured without Safe Parser)
signatures.remediation: Validate and sanitize document URLs and file headers prior to passing to document parsing engines to avoid SSRF and parser exploit primitives.
